items.title: 13.3 Process of Finding Derivative f'(x) by Definition (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum bachon! Pichle sabaq (13.2) mein humne derivative ki definition parhi thi: derivative asal mein ek difference quotient (farq ka hissa) ki limit hai. Aaj ka heading, 13.3, usi definition ko ek kaam ka tareeqa (process) bana deta hai. Yani ab hum sirf definition yaad nahin karenge, balke us se kisi bhi function ka derivative khud nikalna seekhenge.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kitab is heading ke neeche apni koi ibarat nahin likhti; seedha 13.3.1 shuru ho jata hai. Yeh chhota sa taaruf (introduction) hamari taraf se hai, taa ke aap ko pata ho ke aage kya aa raha hai.
Pehle woh formula dobara dekh lijiye jis par yeh poora section khara hai:
\[f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{f(x+\delta x)-f(x)}{\delta x}\]
Is ko aise parhiye: \(x\) mein thori si tabdeeli \(\delta x\) karo, dekho function kitna badla, us badlav ko \(\delta x\) se divide karo, aur phir \(\delta x\) ko zero ki taraf le jao. Jo value bachti hai, wohi derivative hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is section mein do hisse hain:
1. 13.3.1 Notation of Derivative: ek hi derivative ko likhne ke kai tareeqe (symbols) hain, jaise \(f'(x)\), \(\frac{dy}{dx}\), \(y'\), \(Df(x)\). Mukhtalif mathematicians ne mukhtalif symbols banaye. Yahin derivative ki doosri shakal bhi aati hai jo ek khaas point \(x = a\) par derivative deti hai.
2. 13.3.2 Finding \(f'(x)\) by Definition of Derivative: chaar qadam (Step I se Step IV) ka pakka tareeqa. Examples 3, 4 aur 5 mein hum isi tareeqe se \(c\), \(x^{2}\), \(\sqrt{x}\) aur \(\frac{1}{x^{2}}\) ke derivatives nikalenge.
Kyun zaroori hai? Aage aap shortcut formulas (power rule waghera) parhenge. Lekin exam mein aksar likha hota hai "by definition" ya "from first principles"; wahan shortcut ke number nahin milte. Aur shortcut formulas bhi isi definition se saabit hote hain, is liye yeh buniyad (foundation) mazboot honi chahiye.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text:
Shuru karne se pehle do baatein zehan mein pakki kar lijiye:
1. \(\delta x\) ek hi symbol hai: \(x\) mein chhoti si tabdeeli (small change). Yeh \(\delta\) guna \(x\) nahin hai. Isi tarah \(\delta y\) ka matlab hai \(y\) mein tabdeeli.
2. Limit lete waqt hum \(\delta x\) ko cancel kar sakte hain kyun ke \(\delta x\) zero ke qareeb ja raha hai, magar zero hai nahin (\(\delta x \ne 0\)). Agar shuru mein hi \(\delta x = 0\) rakh dein to \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai, jis ka koi matlab nahin. Is liye pehle simplify, phir cancel, aakhir mein limit.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: Socho aap motorway par gaari chala rahe hain. Speedometer jo speed dikhata hai woh "is lamhe" ki speed hai. Lekin speed to faasla taqseem waqt hoti hai, aur ek lamhe mein waqt to zero hai! Hal yeh hai: bohat chhote waqt (\(\delta t\)) mein tay kiya hua faasla dekho, divide karo, aur waqt ko zero ki taraf le jao. Derivative bilkul yahi kaam karta hai; 13.3 mein hum is kaam ko qadam ba qadam karna seekhenge.
